L01 | The judgment is choosing the authoritative source and the exact identifier the record calls for.
L02 | The judgment is deciding how strongly the evidence supports the claim and how plainly to state its limits.
L03 | The judgment is choosing an exact quotation that fairly represents the speaker’s point and deciding whether the evidence distinguishes the proposed cause from plausible alternatives.
L04 | The judgment is deciding what to inspect at the destination to tell whether everything that should have arrived actually did.
L05 | The judgment is deciding which possibilities the search could have detected and which remain open.
L06 | The judgment is choosing words or silence that offer calm attention without turning it into unsolicited advice.
L07 | The judgment is deciding which other source could change the answer and when the sources checked support the answer as worded.
L08 | The judgment is deciding which work warrants another reviewer and which reviewer’s perspective is most likely to expose a missed error.
L09 | The judgment is deciding which event the timestamp should mark and what precision and time zone the reader needs.
L10 | The judgment is choosing a test that can establish both whether the noted fact holds and whether a missing qualification changes its meaning.
L11 | The judgment is choosing the check whose result distinguishes completed work from a mere attempt.
L12 | The judgment is deciding where in the workflow to put the recurring step so it prevents the mistake before it happens.
L13 | The judgment is choosing an observation that distinguishes a program using the saved setting from one behaving the same way without it.
L14 | The judgment is deciding which external source is authoritative for the specific claim and whether it confirms every part of the answer being marked as checked.
L15 | The judgment is choosing a safe, representative failure that the test or monitor should detect.
L16 | The judgment is identifying which neighboring fields or behaviors could share the defect or be disturbed by the fix.
L17 | The judgment is choosing a nondisruptive check that can distinguish actual loss from a wrong location or a faulty reading.
